findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_coverage, find_contractors, get_booking_status · Private data: get_booking_questions, start_booking · Public sink: get_booking_questions, get_available_windows, start_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_coverage, find_contractors, get_booking_status · Private data: get_booking_questions, start_booking · Public sink: get_booking_questions, get_available_windows, start_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
